pages.title: The Cosmic Web
pages.text: $(thing)The Cosmic Web$()$(br2)On the largest scales the galaxies are not scattered evenly: they lie along filaments and sheets round enormous voids, the shape gravity has pulled the dark matter into since the Big Bang. Unlocks the cosmic web simulation.

$(thing)Insight$(): 220$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Galactic Dynamics, The Hot Big Bang, Interstellar Medium.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Galactic Filament, 2 Redshift Lens.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): For the Universe to be exactly flat, the mass in each cubic metre must balance its expansion rate H against gravity's constant G. Write how much mass ρ each cubic metre must hold.
